name: Quét vòng nhanh
desc: the same full-turn level sweep as `ring` but FAST (a decisive strike): the head runs the front half in about two frames (born one frame before the hit, at the hit it is at the target) and the back half one frame later, then the stroke is pulled in from the tail; made for a body that cuts from a loaded pose to a hit pose (pose to pose); use it with the body centre as --from and the target side as --to, set k, roll, u0, u1 and r with --swing

warn: pop: frame 4 -> 5 loses 50 % of the peak
linger: the last 11 of 23 frames carry under 2 % of the peak
empty0: the first frame is empty
